title: Choice
summary: A form field that picks one option, or several, from cards: each a title, a caption, an icon and a badge, in a grid that wraps on a phone. One option is a radio group the arrow keys move through; several are checkboxes. Chosen cards have a filled mark and a heavier primary edge; invalid cards an error edge and a message under them.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

multiple.description: Several options: the cards are checkboxes in a group. Without it one option is chosen, the cards are a radio group.

columns.description: The grid: auto fills the width with cards no narrower than --sf-choice-min-inline-size (15rem); a number is the most columns, fewer where a card would be narrower than that, so a phone stacks them.

label.description: The visible name of the field over the cards; it names the group. Without it the host's aria-label does.

hint.description: The line under the cards; it describes the group.

name.description: The form name: one entry with the chosen value, or one entry per chosen value when multiple.

required.description: The form is not sent while nothing is chosen (value-missing).

disabled.description: No card can be chosen or focused, and nothing is sent with the form; a disabled fieldset does the same. An option's own disabled turns off its card alone.

invalid.description: The page's verdict: the cards not chosen take the error edge, aria-invalid is set, and error-message shows under them.

error-message.description: Shown in place of the hint while invalid.

value.description: The chosen option's value; multiple, the chosen values joined by commas in the order of the options ('' when nothing is). The value attribute is the default a form reset returns to; set from code (a string, or a list of values) it says nothing. The property selected gives the values as a list.

items.description: The options, [{value, label, caption?, icon?, badge?, disabled?}]: each a card with its title (label, or title), a caption under it, an icon in a box before it and a short badge beside the title. A property, the JSON island or the attribute as JSON. An option without a value or repeating one is left out.

input.summary: A person chose an option or, multiple, turned one off. Sent before change, with the same detail; the inner inputs' own events do not leave the host.

change.summary: The value changed by the person, once per press, as a native radio group's or checkbox's: detail.value is the new value, detail.values the chosen values, detail.item the option pressed, detail.checked whether it is chosen now. A value set from code, a form reset and a restore say nothing.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: drawing cards of its own over the field
trusting the submitted values without checking them on the server

keyboard: Single: Tab reaches the chosen card (or the first); the arrow keys move to the next or previous card and choose it, wrapping at the ends
Multiple: Tab reaches each card; Space turns it on or off
accessibility.focus: The focus ring is drawn on the card whose input has keyboard focus; a press draws none.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-input-choice to pick one or several of a few options that need words to tell apart -- a site's kind, a page type, a template, a field type, a backup target, a plan -- shown all at once as cards.
do_not: Do not use it for a long list; use sf-input-select or sf-input-lookup
Do not use it for two or three short words; use sf-button-group (segmented) or sf-radio
Do not draw cards of your own with radios inside; give the options to the field
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-input-choice label="Тип сайта" name="kind" items='[{"value": "site", "label": "Сайт", "caption": "Страницы и разделы", "icon": "language"}, {"value": "shop", "label": "Магазин", "caption": "Каталог и заказы", "icon": "storefront"}]'></sf-input-choice>
